title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return the index of `target` if it exists in `nums`, otherwise -1.

hints.text: Keep a low and high index and repeatedly inspect the middle element.
If the middle value is too high, search the left half; if too low, search the right half.
Stop when low exceeds high — the target is not in the array.

solution.explanation: Classic binary search on a sorted array.
